title: Hosted / Team Mode Surface Audit v1

current_state.summary: Hosted/team mode does not exist in Rig Relay. Fleet controller (enterprise/fleet_controller.py) runs multiple instances via subprocess spawn — not true multi-tenancy. Headless server exists for single-instance headless mode. Tenant concept exists (TenantRegistry, tenant-scoped event dispatch, TenantPermissionEvaluator with 6 permission levels) but there is no hosted API, no multi-user session model, no remote WebSocket auth, no SSO/SCIM, no data residency controls, no billing model, and no hosted GitHub integration. Postgres adapter is not yet implemented.
current_state.maturity: partial — tenant models exist; fleet controller for subprocess-based multi-instance; no true hosted mode

hosted_architecture_options.description: Each user runs their own Rig Relay instance locally. Evidence local-first. No shared state. No team features.

Users run local Rig Relay instances. Team state shared via coordination store (Postgres-backed). Evidence local-first but synchronized. Cockpit can view team projections. Hosted instance optional for shared WebSocket.
Single hosted Rig Relay instance serves a team via WebSocket. Evidence stored in hosted Postgres. Users authenticate via hosted API. Admin manages tenants, permissions, rate limits.
hosted_architecture_options.recommended_for: startups (15-100), teams wanting zero local setup

hosted_architecture_options.description: Hosted Rig Relay serves multiple tenants with full isolation. Postgres row-level security or schema-per-tenant. Per-tenant rate limits, evidence stores, and admin panels. SSO/SCIM integration.

recommended_v1_hosted_boundary.what_remains_local: user's workspace (file system, git repo, subprocess execution); agent loop execution; tool invocation; mission execution; local evidence artifacts (JSONL source-of-truth)
recommended_v1_hosted_boundary.what_moves_to_postgres: coordination store (sessions, tasks, leases, artifacts, conflicts); team projections; permission profiles; rate-limit budgets; mission topology; fleet health
recommended_v1_hosted_boundary.what_remains_file_artifact_truth: all evidence artifacts (JSONL); all receipts; all audit logs; all permission probe results; all schema validation results; all procurement packs
recommended_v1_hosted_boundary.what_apis_are_needed: WebSocket auth for remote clients (mutual TLS or token-based); coordination sync API; projection sync API; tenant management API (admin only); telemetry policy API
recommended_v1_hosted_boundary.what_not_to_host_yet: agent loop execution (stays local); tool invocation (stays local); GitHub App auth (stays local per-user); workspace file system (stays local)

hosted_requirements.status: partial — TenantRegistry exists; no query/connection-level isolation
partial — TenantPermissionEvaluator exists; no role hierarchy
partial — evidence artifacts support this; no hosted UI

hosted_tests_required: test_tenant_isolation_data_level — sabotage: tenant A query returns tenant B data, verify blocked
test_tenant_isolation_query_level — sabotage: tenant A connection accesses tenant B schema, verify blocked
test_rbac_admin_role_enforcement — sabotage: non-admin performs admin action, verify blocked
test_product_telemetry_opt_out_preserves_evidence — contract: disable telemetry, verify receipts and audit logs still emitted
test_remote_contribution_disabled_preserves_local_evidence — contract: disable remote contribution, verify local evidence intact
test_postgres_unavailable_fail_closed — substrate: kill Postgres, verify cockpit degrades gracefully and blocks mutations
test_backup_export_delete_per_tenant — substrate: backup tenant A, verify tenant B data not included
test_cross_tenant_event_policy_enforcement — adversarial: tenant A publishes cross-tenant event without permission, verify blocked
